title: Wall Street set for positive start to 2018 Business
text:
Stocks rally to kick off 2018 Wall Street FOXBusiness
Facebook Twitter Comments Print video 2018 stock market expectations FBN's Dagen McDowell, The Wall Street Journal's assistant editorial page editor James Freeman and Vision 4 Fund Distributors Vice President Heather Zumarraga discuss their expectations for the stock market in 2018.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq clinched fresh record highs Tuesday, as U.S. stocks pushed higher to kick off a new year of trading.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed about 104 points higher at 24,823. The S&P 500 rose 22 points to 2,695. The Nasdaq Composite advanced 103 points to 7,006.
Tech stocks carried their momentum into the start of 2018 with a gain of more than 1% during the session, as Apple ( AAPL ), Facebook ( FB ) and Microsoft ( MSFT ) all climbed. The tech sector is coming off a year in which it jumped 37%, making it the top performer among the S&P’s 11 sectors.
Health care, energy and consumer discretionary stocks also fueled Tuesday’s rally.
